answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a non-transferable identity bond: each new agent must post a stake and solve a unique proof-of-work before it can act, and a jury slashes that stake if the identity is duplicated or its work is plagiarized. A gale of fake accounts therefore becomes a voyage of real expense, since every ripple of copied text forfeits the bond, so scaling the attack scales the attacker's loss while honest agents reclaim their stake.
